name: Six-Rotor Annular Assembly
description: Engineering drawing of a single-solid six-rotor annular assembly: a base plate carrying an annular housing ring whose front lip has a 21-tooth internal crown, a centre seven-lobe rotor with a raised hex drive, and five seven-lobe satellite rotors on a pitch circle. A front view, a section, and rotor and tooth details specify the part. Dimensions are in millimetres.
